### Biologiniai elgesio pagrindai

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

### Psichikos sveikata ir klinikinis mokslas

### Psichologijos mokslas ir tyrimai

Groups: 5 · Skills: 31

[psychologicalScienceAndInquiry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Psychology explains behavior and mental processes through empirical evidence, multiple levels of analysis, and ethical inquiry. Its explanations are provisional and require stronger support than anecdote or authority.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip psichologai kruopščiais tyrimais nagrinėja elgesį ir psichikos procesus.

#### Įrodymai ir interpretavimas

Skills: 6

[evidenceAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/evidenceAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Quantitative summaries and research transparency help discriminate robust patterns from noise and misleading causal stories.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip įrodymai ir skaidri analizė pagrindžia tyrimų išvadas.

##### Analizės atkuriamumas

[analyticalReproducibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/analyticalReproducibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why access to reported methods, data, and analytic decisions allows independent verification of a result.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kodėl aiškūs metodai ir analizės sprendimai leidžia rezultatus patikrinti nepriklausomai.

##### Klaidinantys kintamieji

[confoundingVariables.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/confoundingVariables.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify background factors that move with a proposed cause and could produce an observed group difference.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink kitus veiksnius, galinčius paaiškinti grupių skirtumus.

##### Koreliacija ir priežastingumas

[correlationAndCausation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/correlationAndCausation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider reversed direction and third-variable explanations when two psychological measures vary together.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk sąsają nuo įrodymų, kad vienas psichologinis veiksnys sukelia kitą.

##### Aprašomoji statistika tyrimuose

[descriptiveStatisticsInResearch.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/descriptiveStatisticsInResearch.data.ts)

[evidenceQuality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/evidenceQuality.data.ts)

[studyReplication.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/studyReplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why repeating a psychological investigation with new observations helps assess the robustness and generality of a result.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kodėl tyrimo pakartojimas padeda patikrinti rezultatų patikimumą.

Skills: 4

[foundationsAndPerspectives.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/foundationsAndPerspectives.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lt):** Susipažink su skirtingais psichologijos požiūriais ir mokslo tikslais.

[psychologicalPerspectives.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/psychologicalPerspectives.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink, kaip skirtingi psichologiniai požiūriai aiškina tą patį elgesį.

[scopeOfPsychologicalScience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/scopeOfPsychologicalScience.data.ts)

### Pojūčiai ir suvokimas

Groups: 5 · Skills: 23

[sensationAndPerception.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensationAndPerception.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip jutiminiai signalai virsta mus supančio pasaulio patirtimi.

#### Kūno ir cheminiai pojūčiai

Skills: 6

[bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Touch, pain, balance, body position, smell, and taste rely on partly distinct receptor and processing pathways. Their psychological importance lies in how signals become conscious experiences and guide action, not in cataloguing anatomy alone.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip lytėjimas, skausmas, uoslė, skonis ir kūno pojūčiai formuoja patirtį.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, kaip ankstesnė patirtis ir aplinkybės veikia kvapų atpažinimą.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išsiaiškink, kaip skonis ir uoslė susijungia į skonio potyrį.
